{{Quote|I've spend years trying to help the Republic win. Did a lot of things I'd rather forget. Then I see the Voss.|Rosk Shiran|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Rosk Shiran''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] agent of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. After many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of doing questionable things in government service, he eventually came to [[Voss]] and was stunned by the honesty and serenity of its people, deciding to retire, and settle there.
